description:
Runs 9 automatic checks on BRF text (mapping, line length, page length, CRLF, form feed, round trip, ...). Does not check paper quality or dot depth (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.).
한국어: BRF 텍스트를 9개 항목으로 자동 검증합니다.
name: braille_verify_brf
title: Verify BRF text (9 checks)
